caption: A coin is flipped into the air and caught as it comes down.

sa.check: A coin is flipped into the air.
It rises and comes back down.
It is caught as it comes down.
The coin tumbles as it flies rather than travelling flat.
The flip comes first and the catch follows.

pc.expect: The coin slows as it rises, peaks, and falls quicker on the way down.
pc.fail: The coin hangs at the top; or it rises at an unchanging speed; or it falls at one slow unchanging drift.

pc.expect: It goes up and comes back along nearly the same line to the hand.
pc.fail: The coin drifts far to one side with nothing touching it; or it jinks in mid-air; or it keeps rising out of the frame.

pc.expect: The coin tumbles end over end in the air and stops only in the hand.
pc.fail: The coin stops spinning in mid-air and hangs; or it reverses its spin; or it sets off again after being caught.

pc.expect: The hand closes on the coin and the coin stops there.
pc.fail: The coin passes through the hand; or the hand closes and the coin keeps falling; or the coin stops above the open hand.

pc.expect: One coin is in the air throughout.
pc.fail: The coin vanishes at the top or a second one appears; or it turns into another object; or it merges with the hand.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The coin's colour and size and the background stay the same.
pc.fail: The coin changes colour or size in flight; or the background rearranges between frames; or the hand changes.

note: The hand is kept as the minimal trigger and catcher; the person behind it is not judged.
